description: This header defines interfaces and classes for managing F1-U gateway bearers in a 5G network, including notifier interfaces, gateway creation, and management for both DU and CU-UP roles.

classes.name: f1u_du_gateway_bearer_rx_notifier
classes.description: Interface for a notifier that handles new PDU events inside the F1-U gateway.

classes.name: f1u_du_gateway_bearer
classes.description: Interface for an F1-U gateway bearer, including methods to stop and get bind address.

classes.name: f1u_du_gateway
classes.description: Abstract class providing interface to create and manage F1-U bearers, including methods to create bearers and get bind address.

classes.name: f1u_du_udp_gateway
classes.description: Derived class for UDP-based F1-U gateway, providing additional method to get bind port.

methods.name: create_du_bearer
methods.description: Creates a new F1-U DU bearer with specified parameters.

methods.name: get_du_bind_address
methods.description: Retrieves the bind address for the DU.

methods.name: get_bind_port
methods.description: Retrieves the UDP bind port for the UDP gateway.
